name: MaxionBench evaluation card
evaluation_object: Agentic retrieval infrastructure under conformance-gated, single-node local deployment assumptions.
primary_claim: Agentic retrieval systems require decision-audit evaluation across conformance, quality, post-insert top-10 retrievability, max-row p99 latency, normalized context-cost proxy, budget stability, and objective sensitivity.

supported_claims.claim: Strict 200 ms max-row p99 deployment selects FAISS CPU with bge-small for S1, S2, and S3 in the archived local run bundle.
supported_claims.scope: single local machine, archived MaxionBench bundle
reported MaxionBench objectives and budget rows

supported_claims.claim: The S3 pgvector quality-first edge is not substantive under matched-query audit.
S2 Qdrant does not hide a quality or post-insert retrievability win in the paired checks.
supported_claims.scope: standard Qdrant paired check, bounded same-orchestration mini-bundle, and larger same-machine two-repeat paired check

not_supported: claims about managed vector database deployments
second-machine, distributed, GPU, or managed-service robustness claims
high-probe/high-ef service-engine sweep claims beyond the targeted checks in submission/evidence/experiments

datasets.name: D4 MaxionBench S1/S2 processed text bundles

compute_scope.accelerator_use: no accelerator-backed benchmark row is reported
compute_scope.public_repository_note: Host identifiers, OS patch level, user names, and machine-local paths are intentionally omitted from public files.

known_limitations: Only one local hardware profile is included.
Max-row p99 is computed from the archived configured B2 client rows and repeats; it is not a hardware-population interval.
The S2 same-machine reruns cap post-insert retrievability events for bounded turnaround.
The artifact evaluates retrieval infrastructure, not generated answer quality.
Dataset hosting URLs must be anonymized and finalized before submission.
